target: acceptance 4 — triage must not buy extra attempts. The bound stays at two.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/build/SKILL.md"; n=$(grep -A6 -i "triage" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | grep -ci "does not.*extra attempt\|no additional attempt\|within.*existing bound\|not increase"); two=$(grep -c "two escalated attempts" "$f"); printf '{"stated":%s,"boundIntact":%s}' "$n" "$two"
